metadata.description: Open-source Agent Skills for architects, by Gaia Computer Technologies, Inc.

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: An AI assistant for the architect's working week: briefs, sites and planning research, drawings (DXF, diagrams, site maps, massing), Rhino/Revit/IFC connectors, specs, cost and carbon checks, minutes, RFIs, site reports, contract letters, bids and fee proposals, and the hard conversations. Every number shows its basis; nothing is fabricated.
